declaration.question: Does removing positive-class weighting explain improved raw probability quality?
declaration.intervention: Only classifier scale_pos_weight changes within each recipe/fold pair.
held_fixed: applicant role memberships and row order
feature build and selected input columns
all other classifier parameters, including seed, threads and number of trees
declaration.positive_weight: Use that fold's actual earlier fitted weight for both recipes; unweighted is 1.
declaration.deciding_observation: Unweighted raw Brier score and log loss improve in both recipes across all five matched folds; compare predicted prevalence with observed prevalence and report ranking tradeoffs.
declaration.reference_check: Each original-weight refit must reproduce its frozen raw predictions within 1e-10.
declaration.selection: No search, early stopping, calibration fitting, model promotion or threshold changes.
declaration.limits: Retrospective mechanism check on previously exposed random groups, conditional on selected recipes and model seed. Not a population causal claim, full search-policy ablation, or future-cohort proof.
